variables.metaDesc: Every variable ItsBagelBot can expand in a reply, including {user}, {args}, {random}, {count}, {uptime} and {followage}, with syntax and a worked example.
variables.title: Every variable.
variables.lead: A clear collection of the variables the bot can expand in your replies, grouped the way you use them.
variables.note: Unknown or disabled variables stay visible as written, and an empty value can fall back with {name|fallback}.
